messages.content: 今天北京的日落時間是什麼時候？

function.name: calculate_sunrise
function.description: Calculate the time of sunrise for a specific date and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which sunrise time needs to be calculated.

date.description: The date for which sunrise time needs to be calculated in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, current date is considered. Default: 1998-12-03

format.description: Format in which the time should be returned. If not provided, default format 'HH:MM' is considered.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a function that calculates sunset times. I can help you find the sunrise time for Beijing today if that would be useful.
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天北京的日落时间是什么时候?" They want sunset time. But we have only function to calculate sunrise. We cannot compute sunset directly. We can approximate? But we can't call a function for sunset. We could respond that we don't have sunset function. Or we could ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should say we can only calculate sunrise. Ask if they want sunrise instead.
